said.meaning: the 4 keeps the arm of its crossbar past the stem; spacing is measured from the stem, so that the arm joins the letter on its right as in edition 1

four: the crossbar runs on 16 past the stem; the spacing body is the 4 without the arm (the flush 4), so the next letter stands 6 from the stem and the arm reaches 10 into it: where that letter has ink, the arm joins it (both ink); where not, it stands out

pairs.4K: joins the stem of the K, as in edition 1
pairs.4O: joins the lower left of the O
pairs.4T: does not reach the stem of the T; stands out under the crossbar of the T

word: NOT4K from the base forms with the gap of 6 now shows three joins of edition 1 by itself (T over the shoulder of the O, the 4 under the crossbar of the T, the crossbar of the 4 into the stem of the K)
nKept: the N stays stencil (nothing said against it)
